mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate sympathomimetic effects and increase risk of hypertensive crisis; dapagliflozin increases euglycemic DKA risk which may be masked or complicated by MAOI use; additive effects on glucose metabolism and cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, blood pressure regularly, and watch for signs of hypertensive crisis or euglycemic DKA; consider alternative antidepressant if possible; counsel on dietary tyramine restriction.
